name: WIN Waste Innovations
notes: Moved from the catalog default utility-account family to the trash-specific waste-hauler family. Researched from the public win-waste.com My Account page (Sign In with Username and Password, Remember me, Forgot password?, Forgot Username?, Make a one time payment, Sign up), the Sign up form (Username, Email, First name, Last name, optional Primary and Mobile phone), the Charges and Fees page, and the public one-time payment page on web.ebppay.com that My Account links to (Account Number with dashes + ZIP Code; so ebppay.com is in officialDomains); never signed in or submitted anything. The Charges and Fees page says a recurring Manual Payment Administrative Fee applies until the customer enrolls in AutoPay (amount not published: fees.notes, no engine fee; cross-owner request for a recurring non-AutoPay invoice fee). It also lists fuel and environmental charges (percentages of invoice charges) and overage fees. Paperless, payment plans, late fees and the AutoPay schedule are not described publicly: paperless is left at the family default, payment arrangements and online cancellation are unsupported (inferred, call 866-WIN-WASTE). Customer service 866-946-9278.

guest_pay.note: Enter your full account number with dashes and your ZIP code to make a one-time payment without signing in.

autopay.note: Enrolling in AutoPay ends the recurring Manual Payment Administrative Fee on your invoices.

payment_arrangement.note: Payment plans are not offered online. Call WIN Waste customer service at 866-WIN-WASTE (866-946-9278).

cancel_service.note: Service changes and cancellations are handled by customer service. Call 866-WIN-WASTE (866-946-9278).

notes: A recurring Manual Payment Administrative Fee is charged on invoices until you enroll in AutoPay (amount set on your invoice).

help.title: Charges and fees on your invoice
paragraphs: Manual Payment Administrative Fee: a recurring charge that helps cover the cost of processing payments. It stays on your invoices until you enroll in AutoPay.

Fuel charge and environmental charge: recurring charges that recover part of WIN Waste's fuel, environmental and regulatory costs. For collection service they are percentages of the invoice and can change; they are not government taxes or fees.

Overage fee: charged when a container is overfilled, the lid cannot close, or waste is placed on or around it. Contact customer service at 866-WIN-WASTE to add a pickup or change container size or frequency.

help.title: Ways to pay your WIN Waste bill
paragraphs: Sign in to My Account with your username and password to pay, or choose Make a one time payment to pay without signing in. For a one-time payment, enter your full account number with dashes (for example 11-1234-1111) and your ZIP code; if there is a zero right after the first dash, leave it out.
Enroll in AutoPay in My Account to avoid the Manual Payment Administrative Fee. Questions: 866-WIN-WASTE (866-946-9278).

help.title: How to sign up for My Account
paragraphs: On the My Account page choose Sign up and enter a username, your e-mail address, first and last name, and optionally a primary and mobile phone number. Forgot your username or password? Use the Forgot Username? or Forgot password? links on the sign-in page.

extra.intent: Using WIN Waste Innovations' help pages, find which recurring invoice fee stops once you enroll in AutoPay. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: The Manual Payment Administrative Fee stops once you enroll in AutoPay.
